subject: Demo: Novus Retail — qualification & times
messages:
From: Ari Turner <ari.turner@novusretail.com>
To: sales@redwood.ai, info@redwood.ai
Cc: Rashida Khan <rashida.k@novusretail.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo & pricing — Novus Retail

Hi Redwood sales team,

I signed up for the self-serve plan this week and would love a short demo to see how Redwood would fit into our search and support workflows. A few quick details to help scope the call:

- Use case: Improve product search relevance across web and mobile; route customer support tickets to the right team using a triage classifier.
- Volume: ~50k queries/day currently, expecting growth to ~150k/day in 6 months (peaks during promos ~220 requests/sec).
- Timeline: pilot in Jan 2027, decision by end of Feb.

Would appreciate a 30-minute walkthrough and any prep we should do on our side. Also curious about SOC2/compliance info — we may need that early.

Thanks,
Ari Turner
Director of Product
Novus Retail
ari.turner@novusretail.com

--
Attachment: none (signed up via site)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Turner <ari.turner@novusretail.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo & pricing — Novus Retail

Hi Ari — great to see your signup, thanks for the details. I'm Ben from the SDR team, I'll set up the intro demo. A couple quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session:

1) For the search use case, are you planning to use generative re-ranking or embeddings+brute-force? (approx preferred approach)
2) Can you share an estimated average query length / token size and whether queries are multi-turn?
3) For the support triage, will the classifier run on full ticket text or just subject lines?

We can do a 30-minute walkthrough. Here are a few 30-min slots I'm holding next week (all PST):
- Tue 11/24 10:00–10:30
- Wed 11/25 14:30–15:00
- Thu 11/26 09:00–09:30

If none of those work I can loop Hannah in to suggest more availability and a quick CS resource. Also attaching our standard SOC2 summary (see attached) — let me know if you need the full questionnaire.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: soc2-summary.pdf

From: Ari Turner <ari.turner@novusretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rashida Khan <rashida.k@novusretail.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo & pricing — Novus Retail

Thanks Ben — answers below:

1) We're leaning toward embeddings + ANN for re-ranking initially — simpler infra for our team, but open to discussing generator-based rerank if you recommend it.
2) Average query length is 3–8 tokens for search; support tickets average ~300–600 tokens. Queries are single-turn for search; support triage would use full ticket text.
3) Triage will run on full ticket bodies.

Slots: Tue 11/24 10:00 PST works for us (I'll invite Rashida, our Head of Ops).

Also: we will need a SOC2 report and a short note on data retention and where logs live. If you could share a short checklist of what to prepare for the demo (sample data, sample tickets, accounts to add) that would be great.

Cheers,
Ari

--
Note: Novus prefers Teams links

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Turner <ari.turner@novusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo & pricing — Novus Retail

Hi Ari — thanks for the quick answers and for locking in Tue 11/24 10:00 PST. I'm Hannah, Senior Solutions Engineer at Redwood — I'll run the demo and Monica from CS will join to cover onboarding and pilot success criteria.

Brief agenda for the 30-min session:
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m architecture walk: how Redwood serves search/rerank + triage patterns
- 10m demo with a short dataset (we can use a small excerpt you provide)
- 5m next steps & pilot sizing

Prep items we recommend (optional but helpful):
- A CSV with ~200 product titles + metadata (for search demo)
- 5–10 anonymized support tickets (remove PII) for triage demo
- Your expected SLA targets and peak qps

I've attached a short demo-prep-checklist that outlines file formats and a preferred sample payload. We'll also bring a short SOC2 summary (Ben attached earlier) and can route the full report through our security team once we have an NDA in place.

I'll send a calendar invite to the Teams link you prefer; if Novus needs a specific meeting organizer, let me know and we'll use that account.

Look forward to it — Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

If you need anything else from our side we'll upload the sample CSV and tickets to the HubSpot file link (I'll follow up).

Best,
Ari
